title: King Puviraja Pandaram
biography: Puviraja Pandaram (1565) ruled Jaffna momentarily as a Portuguese client after Cankili I's overthrow. His brief tenure reflects Portuguese attempts to install compliant rulers. Indigenous resistance prevented lasting control.

sections.heading: Biography
content: Puviraja Pandaram (1565) ruled Jaffna momentarily as a Portuguese client after Cankili I's overthrow. His brief tenure reflects Portuguese attempts to install compliant rulers. Indigenous resistance prevented lasting control.

internationalConnections: He sponsored Hindu temples, expanded Tamil scholarship, and managed trade with South India and Arab merchants. His long rule represents Jaffna's last independent golden age before Portuguese intrusion..
